import scanpy as sc
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Set scanpy settings
sc.settings.verbosity = 3
sc.settings.set_figure_params(dpi=80, facecolor='white')

# Load the dataset
adata = sc.read_h5ad('./data/cell_annotation/dataset_debug_restricted.h5ad')

print(f'Initial dataset shape: {adata.shape}')
print(f'Initial genes: {adata.n_vars}')
print(f'Initial cells: {adata.n_obs}')

# Calculate QC metrics
# Calculate mitochondrial gene percentage
adata.var['mt'] = adata.var_names.str.startswith('MT-')
sc.pp.calculate_qc_metrics(adata, percent_top=None, log1p=False, inplace=True)

# Add mitochondrial gene percentage to obs
adata.obs['pct_counts_mt'] = adata.obs['pct_counts_mt']

print(f'QC metrics calculated')
print(f'Mean mitochondrial percentage: {adata.obs["pct_counts_mt"].mean():.2f}')
print(f'Mean total counts: {adata.obs["total_counts"].mean():.2f}')
print(f'Mean n_genes_by_counts: {adata.obs["n_genes_by_counts"].mean():.2f}')

# Filtering cells and genes
# Filter cells with too many mitochondrial genes (>20%)
sc.pp.filter_cells(adata, min_genes=200)  # filter cells with too few genes
sc.pp.filter_genes(adata, min_cells=3)   # filter genes expressed in too few cells

# Filter cells based on QC metrics
adata = adata[adata.obs.pct_counts_mt < 20, :]
adata = adata[adata.obs.total_counts >= 500, :]

print(f'After filtering - cells: {adata.n_obs}, genes: {adata.n_vars}')

# Save raw data
adata.raw = adata

# Normalization
# Normalize to 10,000 reads per cell
sc.pp.normalize_total(adata, target_sum=1e4)

# Log transform
sc.pp.log1p(adata)

# Identify highly variable genes
sc.pp.highly_variable_genes(adata, min_mean=0.0125, max_mean=3, min_disp=0.5)
sc.pl.highly_variable_genes(adata)
plt.savefig('./output/cell_annotation_sonnet4/highly_variable_genes.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()

print(f'Highly variable genes identified: {sum(adata.var.highly_variable)}')

# Keep only highly variable genes for downstream analysis
adata.raw = adata
adata = adata[:, adata.var.highly_variable]

print(f'Final preprocessed dataset shape: {adata.shape}')

# Scale data
sc.pp.scale(adata, max_value=10)

print('Data preprocessing completed successfully')
print(f'Final dataset - cells: {adata.n_obs}, genes: {adata.n_vars}')

# Save preprocessed data
adata.write('./output/cell_annotation_sonnet4/preprocessed_dataset.h5ad')

print('Preprocessed dataset saved to ./output/cell_annotation_sonnet4/preprocessed_dataset.h5ad')
EOF

The preprocessed dataset will be saved as an h5ad file.
